summary: Verified flash fix on production build at http://localhost:8779 and no-regression on live preview. Flash fix is working correctly: html.js class is added synchronously in <head>, html.js [data-prerender]{display:none !important} rule hides the SEO pre-render block BEFORE first paint; src/index.js then removes the node before React mounts. Confirmed via Playwright that with React bundle blocked (simulating slow mount), the pre-render element exists in DOM but computed display === 'none' — i.e., it would never visibly paint. With JS disabled, the pre-render block is fully visible to crawlers (display:block, correct <h1>). SEO content preserved: raw HTML served from localhost:8779 contains data-prerender block, exactly one <h1> 'Where the light still runs wild.', 512 words of marketing copy. sitemap.xml and robots.txt return 200. No regression on live preview: hero loads, exactly one <h1> in live DOM, no [data-prerender] (as expected on dev server), all section testids present (nav/contact/etc.), Insights page loads with key gate and unlocks with 'bill-insights-2026' key.
critical_code_review_comments: prerender.cjs: injectIntoRoot's second branch (fallback when not literal) uses a simple string replace that could duplicate the block on re-runs — benign for postbuild but worth noting.
index.js directly mutates rootElement.querySelector before createRoot. React StrictMode double-invokes effects, not render; removing the DOM pre-render before createRoot is correct and safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flash fix verified with 3 scenarios: (1) raw HTML has block + 1 h1 + 512 words + sitemap/robots 200; (2) JS-disabled context shows pre-render visible to crawlers (display:block); (3) JS-enabled context with React bundle aborted — pre-render in DOM but display:none thanks to html.js CSS, so no visible flash. Live preview (dev server) correctly does NOT contain data-prerender block.
